'''D-55i''' is the new I variant of [[D-55]] added in ''Update Executive''. It comes from the front instead of the back, and has a higher-pitched version of the ambience from its normal counterpart. When you hear it, hide in a Blue Locker/White Cabinet, and make sure to hide away from its path, as it leaves a trail of fire that damages even while hidden.
